description: Count the defrost cycles the per-cycle result lines show as completed, against a closing summary that claims a higher count. DISTILL-CANARY-b04c2b59

files.README.md:
# Innismore Cold Store - defrost controller

Each coil runs a defrost cycle on a fixed schedule. A cycle line reports its
own result: ok when the cycle ran to completion, aborted when the controller
cut it short. The nightly summary is written by a separate reporting job.

    <time> DEFROST coil=<id> duration_min=<n> result=ok | aborted
